summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily repurchase activity under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, as required by ASX rules. The board previously authorized up to $1 billion in aggregate for Class A and Class B common stock. The filing provides ASX disclosures as exhibits, noting forward-looking statements about market conditions and regulatory factors. No specific terms (price, shares, premium) are provided beyond the program ceiling. This is a routine update on capital return execution. Watch for repurchase pace and aggregate remaining authorization in future filings.
